correctness.rationale: The exactly normalized matrix is partitioned into far-upper, far-lower and near-diagonal blocks. Uniform geometric rank-one expansions are summable except the far-upper zero-order part, where a dyadic-shell triangular trace-class lemma gives a convergent nuclear sum for alpha>2. The weakly-null positive block polynomials give lower bound c L^(2-alpha) in output norm squared and exclude compactness at the endpoint and boundedness below. The source establishes boundedness at alpha=2.
